_comment: DIP (untrained U-Net) FPM reconstruction of 32a (parallel-beam objective-FZP scan, 30 keV, dr = 250 nm, kc = 2.00 um^-1): bright field rings 0-2 (60 images); crop 512 px; 30 iterations (final state used)

dip._shift_mode_options: image: per-image lateral image shift (units: camera pixels; e.g. sample/optics drift); illumination: per-image illumination wave-vector correction (units: crop spectrum pixel dk). Both bounded by shift_max via tanh.
dip._select_comment: selected iteration = earliest evaluation with validation band misfit <= (1 + select_tol) x minimum
dip._mask_comment: mask_vignetted: FOV model excludes pixels where the model direct beam leaves the pupil (needed for large crops); off here to keep the 512-crop results as reported

_comment_registration: input = registered stacks: stage-rounding shift (prep_32a_reg.py) + pairwise network (register_32a.py) + model-based refinement (register_to_model.py)
_comment_posaffine: input: fpt_output_32a_bf_aff/work = stage-rounding correction + posaffine step (mechanical image drift removed, pupil parallax of the contrast focus kept; defocus/astig from the contrast focus)
